body:
Self-contained specification for zero-ask 5-column policy enforcement across send_command_input, manage_task, and subagent tools (building on normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive, sed_file, notebook_edit, and notebook_execution from predecessor tickets):

1. `hooks/policy/constants.mjs` & `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs`:
   - Export `STDIN_TOOLS = new Set(['send_command_input'])` in `constants.mjs`.
   - Export `evaluateSendCommandInput(rawArgs, ctx)` in `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs` and wire `if (STDIN_TOOLS.has(name)) return evaluateSendCommandInput(args, ctx);` in `evaluatePayload`:
     1. Cols 1 (`ctx.readonly`) and 2 (`ctx.workerTicket`) -> **hard `deny`** (even when `Terminate === true`).
     2. Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)` (`!norm.ok` -> `deny`). Closed folded keys: `{ commandid, input, terminate, waitms, waitmsbeforeasync, toolaction, toolsummary }` (`commandid` if present must be non-empty string; `terminate` if present must be boolean; `input` if present must be string; `waitms`/`waitmsbeforeasync` if present must be finite number; any other key -> `deny`).
     3. Inspect anchor repos `anchorRepos = ctx.anchors.map((a) => ctx.repoAt(a))`:
        - If `norm.folded.terminate === true && (norm.folded.input === undefined || norm.folded.input === '')`:
          - If `anchorRepos.some((r) => r.adlc && !r.store.ok)` -> `deny`.
          - Otherwise -> `PASS` across Cols 3, 4, and 5.
        - Otherwise (non-empty `Input` or `Terminate !== true`):
          - In Col 3 (`anchorRepos.some((r) => r.adlc && (r.activeRail || !r.store.ok))`) -> **hard `deny`**.
          - In Cols 4 & 5: scan `scanPathLike(rawArgs)` and check every resolved candidate via `gateOnePath` (any `deny` on `protectedRoots`, `boosterDataRoots`, `!repo.store.ok`, `activeRail`, or in Col 4 `implicitRails` -> `deny`); then run `shVerdict = classifyRunCommand({ CommandLine: String(norm.folded.input ?? ''), Cwd: ctx.workspacePaths[0] }, ctx)` (already imported from `./shell.mjs`): return `PASS` **iff** `shVerdict.decision === 'pass'`, and **`deny`** whenever `shVerdict.decision === 'deny' || shVerdict.decision === 'ask'` (`0` `ask` outputs!).
   - Update `evaluateOrchestrationTool(name, rawArgs, ctx)` for `manage_task` and subagent tools (`invoke_subagent`, `define_subagent`, `manage_subagents`):
     1. Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)` (`!norm.ok` -> `deny`).
     2. When `name === 'manage_task'`:
        - Require `action = norm.folded.action` to be one of `'list' | 'status' | 'kill' | 'send_input'`; missing or unknown `Action` -> **hard `deny` across all 5 columns**.
        - `'list' | 'status'`: run `scanPathLike(rawArgs)` against `protectedRoots`/`boosterDataRoots`; if clean, return `PASS` across all 5 columns.
        - `'kill'`: Cols 1 & 2 (`ctx.headless`) -> **hard `deny`**; Cols 3, 4, 5 -> if `ctx.anchors.some((a) => { const r = ctx.repoAt(a); return r.adlc && !r.store.ok; })` return `deny`, else `PASS`.
        - `'send_input'`: require `typeof norm.folded.input === 'string'`; Cols 1, 2 & 3 -> **hard `deny`**; Cols 4 & 5 -> run `scanPathLike(rawArgs)` + `gateOnePath` and `classifyRunCommand({ CommandLine: norm.folded.input, Cwd: ctx.workspacePaths[0] }, ctx)`, mapping `'pass'` -> `PASS` and both `'deny'` and `'ask'` -> **`deny`**.
     3. When `name` is `'invoke_subagent' | 'define_subagent' | 'manage_subagents'`:
        - Cols 1 & 2 (`ctx.headless`) -> **hard `deny`**.
        - Cols 3, 4, 5 -> `scanPathLike` (preserving prose skip keys `Prompt`, `SystemPrompt`, `Description`, `Message` so prose mentioning rail filenames does not false-deny, and preserving `run(name, {}, fx.active) -> 'pass'` in `test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs:106-108`), denying on `!repo.store.ok`, protected/booster roots, active rails (Col 3), or implicit rails (Cols 3–4), and mapping any `'ask'` to `'deny'` so every cell returns strictly `'deny'` or `'pass'`.

2. Non-Mutating Bundle-Freshness Test (`test/plugin-layout.test.mjs`):
   - Add a test in `test/plugin-layout.test.mjs` that bundles `hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs` with `esbuild` into a temporary file inside `mkdtempSync` (using the exact banner/define/platform/format options from `package.json` `scripts['build:hooks']`) and asserts byte-for-byte equality with committed `dist/hooks/pre-tool-use.bundle.mjs` without mutating the working tree.

3. Golden Cross-Column Suite (`test/policy-1-5-9-stdin-subagents.test.mjs`):
   - Exhaustively test all 5 context columns (1: `readonly`, 2: `workerTicket`, 3: interactive ADLC with active rails or corrupt store, 4: interactive ADLC without active rails, 5: interactive non-ADLC) across `sed_file`, `notebook_edit`, `notebook_execution`, `send_command_input` (terminate & non-terminate), `manage_task` (`list`, `status`, `kill`, `send_input`, missing/unknown `Action`), and `invoke_subagent`/`define_subagent`/`manage_subagents`, plus read-only inspection of existing `test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json` (60 tools — do NOT edit the fixture) under Col 1 and Col 2, asserting zero `ask` outputs on these evaluators and verifying `classifyRunCommand` parity (e.g. `Input: 'python3 -c "open(\"lib/lock.mjs\",\"w\")"'` and `Input: 'rm -rf /tmp/x'` both return `deny` in Cols 4 & 5).
   - Run `npm run build && npm test && npm run plugin:validate`.

edges.contract: T3 completes all hooks/policy/* changes, rebuilds dist/**, and adds esbuild bundle-freshness verification in test/plugin-layout.test.mjs. T4 modifies only lib/*, bin/agb.mjs, dist/**, website/generated/**, test/fixtures/fake-agy, test/agy.test.mjs, test/doctor.test.mjs, and test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs without touching hooks/**.

title: Enforce zero-ask 5-column policy matrix for send_command_input, manage_task, and subagents
